attack_classes.required_control: DER-only minimal definite lengths and checked arithmetic

attack_classes.vector: deep nesting, excessive TLV nodes, extensions, subject RDNs, subject attributes, or SAN entries
attack_classes.required_control: hard profile-independent depth and count limits

attack_classes.vector: duplicate extension OIDs or duplicate EKU purposes
attack_classes.required_control: reject duplicates before exposing any selected value

attack_classes.vector: critical extension whose semantics are not enforced on the exact-pin branch
attack_classes.required_control: pin profile rejects every critical OID outside its exact understood allow-set

attack_classes.vector: noncanonical time, invalid calendar, malformed DirectoryString, or oversized selected value
attack_classes.required_control: exact DER time/string grammar and bounded selected values

attack_classes.vector: reader grows path, signature, trust, wildcard, hostname, name-constraint, or revocation decisions

implementation_shape.determinism: The same bytes and profile produce the same output or the same error class and offset.

profiles.unknown_critical_behavior: NOT_INTERPRETED; standard verifier or caller remains authoritative

profiles.caller_owned_policy: require extension presence and ca=true before insertion; preserve existing diagnostics
profiles.unknown_critical_behavior: NOT_REJECTED_BY_READER; no critical-extension acceptance claim; the downstream trust-anchor owner remains responsible

profiles.caller_owned_policy: current-time comparison, chain index diagnostics, and strict-mode enablement
profiles.unknown_critical_behavior: NOT_REJECTED_BY_READER; remote standard verifiers own extension semantics

KeyUsage extension presence and digitalSignature bit when present

resource_accounting.depth: The outer Certificate TLV is depth 1. Every entered constructed child increments depth by one. A selected extension's inner root TLV is one deeper than its extnValue OCTET STRING, and all entered inner constructed TLVs count.
resource_accounting.nodes: The outer Certificate TLV is node 1. Every successfully decoded outer or selected-extension inner TLV header increments the node count exactly once, including primitive TLVs and the extnValue OCTET STRING.

traversal_frontier.entered_outer_schema: Certificate and TBSCertificate; explicit version and INTEGER; both signature AlgorithmIdentifier SEQUENCE values and their algorithm OIDs; Certificate signatureValue BIT STRING; issuer and subject Name/RDN/AttributeTypeAndValue; validity and both time values; SubjectPublicKeyInfo, its AlgorithmIdentifier, and subjectPublicKey BIT STRING; issuerUniqueID and subjectUniqueID BIT STRING headers; Extensions wrapper/sequence, every Extension row, extnID, critical, and extnValue.
traversal_frontier.opaque_outer_values: AlgorithmIdentifier parameters and unselected AttributeTypeAndValue values are each counted as one bounded complete TLV but their constructed contents are not entered.
traversal_frontier.entered_selected_values: Supported DirectoryString values and, when selected by the active profile, the complete BasicConstraints, KeyUsage, ExtendedKeyUsage, and SubjectAltName inner grammars.
traversal_frontier.opaque_general_names: In a noncritical SAN, unsupported GeneralName alternatives are counted as one bounded context-specific TLV and their constructed contents are not entered; in a critical SAN they are rejected before exposure.
traversal_frontier.test_only_parser_frontier: A4 may exercise the private TLV reader directly with bounded schema-independent TLV fixtures for max_tlv_depth and max_tlv_nodes; this grants no production generic-reader API.

resource_accounting.enforcement: Certificate size is checked before traversal. Every remaining resource limit is checked before the corresponding slice, allocation, collection insertion, or child entry.
resource_accounting.value_limit_scope: OID, INTEGER, and BIT STRING limits apply to every entered outer mandatory field and selected inner value. max_subject_rdns and max_subject_attributes apply to the subject Name only; issuer Name is structurally traversed but its collections are not retained.
resource_accounting.derived_invariants: Any accepted canonical value under max_certificate_der_bytes uses at most three length octets; a nonminimal longer encoding is X509-DER-NONMINIMAL-LENGTH and a minimal declaration beyond the bounded input is X509-DER-BOUNDS or X509-DER-UNEXPECTED-EOF. IP SAN length is a semantic domain of exactly 4 or 16 octets, not a monotonic resource limit.
resource_accounting.boundary_evidence: Certificate size uses well-formed N-1 and N inputs plus an N+1 input rejected before traversal. Private TLV-reader depth and node ceilings use isolated bounded N-1, N, and N+1 fixtures. Every other monotonic resource limit uses profile-valid N-1 and N fixtures plus an N+1 exact limit error. IP SAN uses accepted 4/16-octet cases and semantic rejection of every other length; length-octet behavior uses canonical short/long, nonminimal, overflow, bounds, and EOF fixtures rather than a fictitious monotonic limit.

canonicality_rules.requirement: Input is one nonempty complete Certificate SEQUENCE and no trailing byte remains.
Only DER definite lengths are accepted; BER/CER indefinite length is rejected.
Length uses short form for values through 127 and the shortest nonzero long form otherwise.
Every offset plus header or content length uses checked arithmetic and stays within the containing TLV and input.
High-tag-number form is rejected; every traversed schema tag has the required class, number, and constructed bit.
SEQUENCE and SET are constructed; BOOLEAN, INTEGER, BIT STRING, OCTET STRING, NULL, OID, and selected strings/times are primitive.
BOOLEAN content is exactly one octet and is 00 for false or FF for true.
INTEGER content is nonempty and has no redundant sign octet.

BIT STRING content contains at least the unused-bit-count octet, its count is 0 through 7, and every declared unused bit is zero; KeyUsage additionally uses DER NamedBitList form with all trailing zero bits removed, no set bit above bit 8, and at least one named bit set.
OID subidentifiers use minimal terminating base-128 form, do not overflow u64, and stay within the OID byte limit.
Every SET OF traversed by the schema is ordered lexicographically by complete encoded child TLV bytes.

Explicit DEFAULT values are rejected for every entered value: v1 Certificate version and Extension critical FALSE globally, plus BasicConstraints cA FALSE whenever that selected extension grammar is entered.
Every mandatory Certificate and TBSCertificate field appears once in schema order; optional context tags appear at most once and in order.
Every Extension SEQUENCE is extnID, optional critical BOOLEAN, and extnValue OCTET STRING with full Extension consumption.
Every extension OID occurs at most once, independent of profile.
Every selected extension value is fully consumed and satisfies its exact selected_extension_contracts entry for BasicConstraints, KeyUsage, ExtendedKeyUsage, or SubjectAltName.
Under X509-PROFILE-PINNED-LEAF, no ExtendedKeyUsage purpose OID repeats; CANON-17 separately requires the sequence to be nonempty.

time_policy.utc_time: Exactly YYMMDDHHMMSSZ; years 50-99 map to 1950-1999 and 00-49 map to 2000-2049.
time_policy.generalized_time: Exactly YYYYMMDDHHMMSSZ; fractional seconds and numeric offsets are rejected.
time_policy.tag_choice: Both UTCTime and GeneralizedTime are deliberately accepted for either validity endpoint because RFC 5280 relying applications must process both; this reader does not enforce the issuer year-to-tag generation rule.
time_policy.calendar: Gregorian month/day and leap-year validation; hour 00-23, minute 00-59, second 00-59; leap seconds are rejected.
time_policy.output: Checked i64 Unix seconds only; the reader accepts no clock and performs no current-time comparison.
time_policy.ordering: notBefore greater than notAfter is X509-DER-VALIDITY-ORDER.

string_policy.presence_rule: SubjectIdentityPresence is true only for a selected OID with a nonempty canonical supported DirectoryString.
validation: UTF8String is valid shortest-form UTF-8 with no surrogate encoding.
PrintableString uses only the ASN.1 PrintableString alphabet.
BMPString length is even and contains no surrogate code unit.
UniversalString length is divisible by four and every code point is a Unicode scalar.
string_policy.teletex_policy: A structurally complete TeletexString no larger than max_directory_string_bytes on a selected subject OID returns SubjectIdentityPresence=false and does not emit X509-DER-STRING because A3 defines no T.61 decoder; malformed supported encodings do emit X509-DER-STRING. A5 owns differential evidence for this intentional compatibility boundary.

extension_policy.unknown_critical_spki_root_acceptor_prof: NOT_INTERPRETED; no critical-extension acceptance claim; the downstream owner remains responsible
extension_policy.critical_default: critical FALSE must be omitted; explicit FALSE is noncanonical DER and rejected

selected_extension_contracts.basic_constraints: SEQUENCE with optional cA BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE followed by optional nonnegative minimal pathLenConstraint INTEGER; explicit cA FALSE is rejected, pathLenConstraint requires cA TRUE, and the sequence is fully consumed.
selected_extension_contracts.key_usage: One fully consumed BIT STRING in DER NamedBitList form; at least one named bit is set, all trailing zero bits are removed, no set bit exceeds bit 8, and digitalSignature bit 0 is returned as a fact.
selected_extension_contracts.extended_key_usage: A fully consumed nonempty SEQUENCE of unique, canonical, bounded OIDs; serverAuth 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.1 presence is returned as a fact.
selected_extension_contracts.subject_alt_name: A fully consumed nonempty GeneralNames SEQUENCE. dNSName is primitive context tag 2 with 1 through 253 IA5 ASCII bytes; A3 performs no DNS-label grammar or normalization. iPAddress is primitive context tag 7 with exactly 4 or 16 octets. In a noncritical SAN, every other GeneralName choice must have canonical outer context-specific TLV framing and bounded content but constructed contents remain opaque and carry no nested-DER canonicality claim. Any unsupported choice in a critical SAN is X509-DER-UNKNOWN-CRITICAL.

error_shape.class: closed enum containing exactly the thirty error_taxonomy codes
error_shape.offset: absolute zero-based byte position in the original certificate input, checked and no greater than input length; offset zero is valid for X509-DER-EMPTY-OR-TRAILING on empty input, and otherwise one-past-end input length is permitted only for X509-DER-UNEXPECTED-EOF
error_shape.numeric_detail: optional fixed-shape u64 observed and limit values, each bounded by max_certificate_der_bytes; no strings or attacker-selected field names

test_obligations: one positive and one exact negative fixture for every canonicality rule
limit-specific resource evidence exactly follows resource_accounting.boundary_evidence rather than assuming every domain is monotonic
depth fixtures count the outer Certificate as depth and node one, count every outer and selected-extension inner TLV exactly once, and exercise both boundaries

error offsets exercise empty-input offset zero, nonempty-input zero, final input byte, permitted one-past-end EOF, and rejection of every offset greater than input length independently of resource-limit fixtures
truncation at every header and content boundary
every duplicate extension position and duplicate EKU purpose
unknown critical and noncritical OIDs under every profile
UTC and GeneralizedTime century, leap-year, calendar, width, suffix, and ordering cases
every supported DirectoryString tag plus malformed and over-limit cases
wrong profile cannot request or observe an unselected field
absent and present-false or empty-policy facts remain distinguishable for BasicConstraints, EKU, KU, and SAN while caller admission decisions remain outside the reader
error class and offset are deterministic across repeated execution
no panic, unsafe code, recursion, ambient authority, or allocation beyond the declared maxima

downstream_handoff.implementation_gate: review_gate.state must be APPROVED and implementation_may_begin must be true before A4 starts

rollback_triggers: an A4 API accepts a clock, server name, trust store, chain, signature, or policy callback
a profile exposes a field not selected by this artifact
a limit is raised, removed, made runtime-ambient, or enforced after allocation
indefinite, nonminimal, trailing, duplicate, or over-depth DER is accepted
the pinned-leaf critical-extension allow-set broadens without independent review
a new production x509-parser call site is added without an A1 and A3 refresh
an error embeds raw peer-controlled DER or unbounded text
no_claim_boundaries: This artifact is a specification and threat model; it does not implement or prove a DER reader.
It does not verify certificate chains, certificate signatures, TLS handshake signatures, trust anchors, hostnames, wildcards, name constraints, policies, revocation, or OCSP.
It does not authorize replacing rustls/WebPKI or treating local facts as standard verification.
It does not authorize removing x509-parser, changing Cargo features, changing Cargo.lock, or cutting over CAP-TLS-X509.
It does not prove compatibility with every incumbent x509-parser input; A5 owns differential and adversarial evidence.
It does not prove the A8 real-peer TLS, mTLS, QUIC, ATP, platform, cancellation, reconnect, or shutdown matrix.
It does not prove performance, release readiness, broad workspace health, or live RCH fleet availability.
It does not authorize unsafe code, file deletion, local Cargo fallback, or implementation before independent approval.
